intro: Return to Bellowfiz is a short delivery quest in Dun Morogh where an adventurer brings a cask of local Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot. It concludes a local favor, rewarding the thirsty driver with a welcome drink.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here's your cask of Evershine, friend. And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this will do just fine. I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
